Forged in Valor.

The Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack for Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 was created in close collaboration with Medal of Honor recipient and U.S. Marine Corps veteran Kyle Carpenter.

Inspired by Kyle's act of valor and recovery journey, the pack brings elements of his story into the game through authentic details drawn from his military service, personal mantras, and experiences.

Every purchase makes a difference. 100% of Activision's net proceeds from the C.O.D.E. Valor Pack will be donated to the Call of Duty Endowment. Available now at www.callofduty.com/valor #CODEValor
